text:
A white multi-jointed robotic arm occupies the upper-left and centre of the frame, mounted over a dark grey benchtop. A black coiled cable runs from the arm's upper joint across the background. The arm's lower link ends near a white aluminium rail/linear-guide assembly running diagonally through the lower half of the image, with a round white knob or disc at its end.

In the foreground right, a white rectangular plastic tray or rack with a grid of twelve square recessed wells sits tilted, resting on the rail; the wells appear empty, with no liquid visible.

A printed marker tag showing a black-and-white QR-style pattern and the number 620 lies behind the tray. Another similar tag appears at upper left beside a white base plate.
